_schema_notes.act: Full official name of the statute (string, required)
_schema_notes.short_name: UPPERCASE abbreviation with year without separator, e.g. ICA1872, ACA1996, ITA2000 (string, optional)
_schema_notes.url: Canonical URL for the statute text on indiacode.nic.in (string, optional)
_schema_notes.retrieved_on: Date retrieved from official source in YYYY-MM-DD format (string, optional)
_schema_notes.status: One of: in_force | amended | repealed | draft | verify_current_status (string, required)
_schema_notes.jurisdiction: ISO-style tag: india | uk | us | … (string, required)
_schema_notes.source_type: One of: act | regulation | judgment | notification | circular (string, required)
_schema_notes.authority: One of: parliament | state_legislature | supreme_court | high_court | tribunal (string, optional)
_schema_notes.sections: Array of section objects (required, at least one entry)
_schema_notes.sections[].section_number: Section number as STRING — always strings like '27', '43A', 'Schedule II' (required)
_schema_notes.sections[].heading: Section heading / title (string, optional)
_schema_notes.sections[].text: VERBATIM statutory text — never paraphrased (string, required)
_schema_notes._ignored: Any top-level key beginning with '_' is automatically ignored by the loader
